title: A Perfect Day in Sitges – Thanks to our private tour
text:
We had an unforgettable day trip from Barcelona to Sitges, all thanks to our incredible host and event manager, Mehdi. From start to finish, he made the experience seamless, relaxing, and full of charm.

Mehdi was incredibly knowledgeable about Sitges’ history and culture and took us to some great local spots: one highlight was a beautiful coffee shop overlooking the beach with comfy seating and amazing views.

He was also so patient with my mom and I and never rushed us when we wanted to slow down, sit for a bit, or browse the local shops. And as a bonus, he captured amazing photos and videos
author: 715caritam

title: One of the best thing I did in my life!
text: It was my first time in Sitges, and omg, I will never forget this experience!! Everything was organized in such a nice way! From the start, the communication was great and easy, nothing to worry about. Very beautiful and suitable experiences for everyone, totally must try.
author: a_zalomajeva

title: Amazing Experience
text: I had an amazing experience with Wine Stories on their wine tour! The vineyards we visited were stunning, and the staff at each location were incredibly welcoming. Our guide made the day informative and fun, sharing lots of interesting stories about the region and the wines we tasted. The group was small, which made the tour feel very personal. I left with a greater appreciation for Spanish wines and some new favorites. Highly recommend this tour for any wine enthusiast!
author: leonsC7659ZO
